title: Transport of a perfect tensor annihilator through a pushforward adjunction
statement: Let f:X→Y be proper, flat, locally finitely presented [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Choose ambient and open derived categories on X and Y, with independent Hom universes [def-pc-derived-category]. Let F:D_QCoh(X)→D_QCoh(Y) be identified by hF with Rf_* [def-pc-derived-direct-image], and let F be left adjoint to a. Let V be any open in Y, P in D_QCoh(X), Q in D_QCoh(Y), and beta:P→a(Q). Let I be perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], and i:I→O_Y[0] a map invertible over V. Suppose i tensor id followed by the left unitor and the adjoint alpha:F(P)→Q of beta is zero [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Then there exist R in D(O_X) and j:R→P such that j becomes invertible on f^-1(V) and j followed by beta is zero. No support hypothesis on Q, perfectness hypothesis on P, or compactness hypothesis on V is assumed.

proof.text: Apply lem-sc-derived-tensor-precomposition-open to get e, hR and open invertibility. Form the full-subcategory object R=⟨L(I)⊗P,hR⟩ and the explicit morphism j=homMk((L(i)⊗id);(e⊗id);λ). No existential object is selected as definition data.

Apply lem-sc-derived-tensor-precomposition-projection. Its factorization of F(j) gives F(j);α=t;((i⊗id);λ;α)=0 by hkill and associativity. Use full-subcategory hom extensionality to obtain this equality before inclusion.

Import the proved additivity of unbounded right derived functors. Transfer additivity to F followed by inclusion along hF, then reflect it through the faithful additive inclusion. Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left and Adjunction.homAddEquiv_zero imply j;β=0 from F(j);α=0. Taking underlying morphisms and pairing with open invertibility gives the required existential.

lean.statement:
theorem adjoint_tensor_annihilator_transport
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ W : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    [∀ W : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    (F : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (hF : F ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y) ≅
      ObjectProperty.ι (schemeDerivedQCohProperty X) ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (adj : F ⊣ a)
    (V : Y.Opens) (P : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (Q : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (β : P ⟶ a.obj Q) (I : schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (hI : Scheme.IsPerfect Y I) (i : I ⟶ 𝟙_ (schemeDerivedCategory Y))
    (hi : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
      V).mapDerivedCategory.map i))
    (hkill : i ▷ (F.obj P).obj ≫ (λ_ (F.obj P).obj).hom ≫
      ((adj.homEquiv P Q).symm β).hom = 0) :
    ∃ (R : schemeDerivedCategory X) (j : R ⟶ P.obj),
      IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.map j) ∧ j ≫ β.hom = 0
